name: Ortur Laser Master H10 20W
tagline: 20W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series — faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
tldr: Ortur Laser Master H10 20W is the 20W SKU on the Ortur ortur laser master h10 line. The H10 is Ortur's step up from the open-frame LM3 line: a more integrated chassis with up to 20W diode power and higher advertised traverse speeds. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Versatile hobby engraving with solid cutting through typical 3–6 mm basswood

priceRange.note: 20W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Higher speed potential on optimized jobs
Large Ortur community and firmware support
Competitive price vs xTool D1 Pro
cons: Still open frame — eye protection required
Less proven long-term than LM3 community volume
Not a CO₂ replacement for acrylic shops
beginnerNotes: Choose 20W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Start with 20W unless you have a clear cutting use case — 40W adds cost with diminishing returns on thick cuts. Pair with Ortur air assist early for cleaner edges.
primaryUse: Integrated open-frame Ortur diode for faster engraving and moderate thin-wood cutting.
